_about: Design FMEA and test plan (DVP&R) for the front corner, PLAN s17 step D. Rated by the scales below (simplified from the AIAG-VDA tables); RPN = S x O x D before and after the recommended actions. Numbers in the text are placeholders ({req:ID} = that requirement's result in the matrix; {veh:key}, {hc:key} = vehicle_derived.json, handcalc_results.json), so they follow the analysis. scripts/dfmea.py renders notes/dfmea.md and refuses to run unless every requirement that is not passing, and every WARN row in the fastener sweep, is covered by a row or a test that says what would close it.

S.10: a wheel loses its location, or the brakes or steering fail, without warning
S.9: the same with warning first (play, noise), or the car fails a rule at technical inspection
S.7: a sudden handling change the driver may not catch
S.5: performance degraded, the car still drives safely
S.3: a small loss the driver may not notice

O.1: prevented by design with a large margin
O.2: margin of 2 or more by a benchmarked method
O.3: margin of 1.5 to 2, or a method with one benchmark
O.4: margin near 1.2 to 1.5, or inputs that are estimates
O.6: margin under 1.2, an assumed input not yet confirmed, or not analysed
O.10: it is the design: it happens

D.1: measured on the part itself before release
D.2: a planned test on the built car catches it
D.3: a planned inspection on the built car catches it
D.5: analysis only, by a benchmarked method

rows.function: Locate the hub bearings and carry the wheel loads for three seasons
rows.mode: Fatigue crack at the housing's inboard bore edge
rows.effect: The bearing cup loosens; the wheel's location is lost
rows.cause: 7075 has no endurance limit; cornering cycles LC2 to LC2i. The unlimited-life screen gives {req:S-07a} (DV-3)
rows.prevention: Duty-spectrum fatigue by Miner's rule: factor {req:S-07c} on every stress (S-07c); the FEA shaped the housing (D14)
rows.detection: Analysis only, on an assumed three-season duty spectrum
rows.action_text: Measure the real load spectrum (T-02), proof-test one upright with strain gauges (T-04), and inspect the bore edge with dye penetrant (T-08) at an interval that stays a judgement until the measured spectrum and a crack-growth estimate set it

closes.S-07a: The unlimited-life claim is replaced by a measured spectrum (T-02), a proof test (T-04) and an inspection interval (T-08): the deviation stays, and is managed

rows.function: Carry the nine load cases below the design yield
rows.mode: The FEA under-predicts the peak stress and the upright yields in combined braking and cornering (LC4)
rows.effect: Permanent set: camber and toe change; a crack can start
rows.cause: A modelling error the plan's plain-section hand check would have caught; the upright has no plain section (DV-2)
rows.prevention: FoS {req:S-06a} at LC4; the method recovers beam theory ({req:S-06c} %), a hole's Kt ({req:S-06g} %) and a Lame ring ({req:S-06h} %); the peak changes {req:S-06d} % between the two finest meshes (still rising: not asymptotic)
rows.detection: Analysis only, by a benchmarked method
rows.action_text: Strain rosettes at the steering-arm root and the housing in the proof test: measured strains within 10 % of the FEA

closes.S-06f: T-04's strains within 10 % of the FEA at two gauged spots: a direct check of the model, standing in for the plain section that does not exist

rows.function: Represent the loads the corner sees on track
rows.mode: The assumed load cases under-estimate the real loads
rows.effect: Every strength margin rests on the wrong base
rows.cause: Load cases from public practice and own assumptions; no measured data (PLAN s4). No case combines a bump with cornering, and no dynamic factor is applied
rows.prevention: Conservative cases: 3 g bump with the bump-stop force, a 45 deg pothole strike, a kerb strike, 1.6 g cornering, 1.5 g braking; the strength checks target 1.5 or more (the upright's fatigue screen falls short: DV-3)
rows.action_text: Strain-gauge the pushrods and compare the measured force per g with the force solver; if a case is exceeded, scale it and re-run run_all.py

rows.function: Keep the handling balance steady over bumps and under braking
rows.mode: The roll centre moves {req:K-08a} mm over +/-25 mm of heave (target +/-15 mm)
rows.effect: If only the front roll centre moved, front TLLTD would range from {veh:tlltd_front_bump25:.1%} (25 mm bump) to {veh:tlltd_front_droop25:.1%} (25 mm droop): the balance shifts on bumps and under braking (in braking pitch the rear adds to it)
rows.cause: No wishbone layout or chassis width tried reaches the target (DV-1); {req:K-08a:.0f} mm here, with the upper pickups held to the assumed chassis's width and the rim's clearance at full lock
rows.prevention: None in this design: no static ARB setting removes a shift that happens in motion. The ARB sets the static balance, and the roll centre reaches ground level only at pothole travel
rows.action_text: Measure the balance shift on track (T-06) and set up for it; for the next chassis, wider upper pickups

closes.K-08a: Not reachable as set (no layout or chassis width tried reaches it); accepted as DV-1, with T-06 measuring the shift so the setup accounts for it. A target relative to the body is the candidate for the next car, through a recorded requirement change

rows.function: Keep the unsprung mass low
rows.mode: The upright weighs {req:M-02} kg against a 0.6 kg target
rows.effect: Slightly more unsprung mass; the corner still meets its 11 kg budget ({req:M-01} kg)
rows.cause: Stiffness and fatigue margins came first (D14, D20; DV-4)
rows.prevention: M-01 passes
rows.detection: CAD mass, weighed on the part
rows.action_text: After T-04 confirms the stress level, pocket the web for a v5 upright and re-run the FEA and fatigue

closes.M-02: A v5 upright under 0.6 kg with the FEA, fatigue and proof test re-run; accepted as DV-4 until then

rows.function: Stay seated on its perches over the whole travel
rows.mode: The 150 lb/in spring goes slack over the last {req:V-05} mm of droop
rows.effect: The spring rattles and can shift on its perch; the wheel rate steps when it re-seats
rows.cause: The softest spring sold for the TTX25 (D21), against the damper's top-out
rows.prevention: A light helper (tender) spring, BOM line D3 (to quote)
rows.action_text: Source a 36 mm ID tender spring, add its solid height to the travel check, and confirm at full droop on the car (T-01)

closes.V-05: The helper spring sourced, its solid height inside the travel, and the main spring seated at full droop on the car (T-01)

rows.function: Keep the bearing cups' press fit and retaining compound inside their temperature limits
rows.mode: The housing passes 120 deg C or the cup seat 150 deg C
rows.effect: The cup fit opens and the retainer softens: the cup creeps and play builds (felt before the bearing fails)
rows.cause: The disc runs at {hc:s16_disc_T_min_C:.0f}-{hc:s16_disc_T_max_C:.0f} deg C (HC-8); heat crosses the mount into the hub and upright
rows.prevention: Floating disc on titanium bobbins (D23): margin {req:S-16} at the high end of the assumed contact conductance
rows.detection: Hand calc with assumed contact conductances (HC-8)
rows.action_text: Thermocouple and temperature labels on the housing over an endurance-length run (T-05); rock each wheel for play before every event (T-08)

rows.function: Hold each joint at its torque for the season
rows.mode: A bolt backs off
rows.effect: Joint play, then the loss of a link
rows.cause: Vibration and thermal cycles
rows.prevention: All-metal prevailing-torque nuts, a screw-locking insert, drilled heads wired in pairs; lengths from the schedule, two threads past every nut (R-09)
rows.detection: Torque stripes inspected before each event (planned)
rows.action_text: Torque every bolt to the schedule and stripe it (T-07); inspect the stripes after shakedown and before each event (T-08)

rows.item: Threads in bought parts (Wilwood PS-1 caliper ears, Kaz rack trunnion blocks)
rows.function: Hold the caliper bolts and the rack bracket bolts
rows.mode: A caliper bolt or a rack bracket bolt strips its thread, or bottoms
rows.effect: Brake or steering mount lost
rows.cause: Neither thread depth is published: the PS-1's ears are taken as tapped through (Wilwood lists a 0.32 in hole), the Kaz block as 2 d deep
rows.prevention: The bolt schedule engages the ear's whole 10.4 mm and 2 d in the block; the fastener sweep marks both as interface WARN rows
rows.action_text: Get Wilwood's and Kaz's drawings before ordering and re-run the bolt schedule; proof-torque each of these bolts to 110 % of its spec on the built car (T-03, T-07)

closes.WARN: Caliper bolt: Wilwood's drawing gives the PS-1's mount thread; the schedule is re-run against it
closes.WARN: Rack bracket bolt: Kaz's drawing gives the block's thread depth; the schedule is re-run against it

rows.function: Set the front roll stiffness at each of three settings
rows.mode: The stiff bar yields or cracks at its shoulder or its splined end
rows.effect: The ARB lets go mid-corner: a sudden balance change
rows.cause: The spline's Kt is assumed (3.0); the heat treatment is not yet verified; infinite life is checked at the largest cornering roll only, without counting bump cycles
rows.prevention: 4340 at 180 ksi; upset 25 mm ends and ground R4 shoulders; static FoS {hc:arb_bar_fos_body:.2f} in the body and {hc:arb_bar_fos_end:.2f} at the spline (S-09); infinite-life FoS {hc:arb_bar_fatigue_fos:.2f} at the largest cornering roll (S-23)
rows.detection: Hand calc with an assumed spline Kt (HC-5)
rows.action_text: Hardness-check the heat treatment against its certificate; measure each bar's rate on the car (T-06); magnetic-particle inspection of the shoulder and spline every season (T-08)

rows.function: Match the designed kinematics
rows.mode: Built hardpoints off: bump steer or static settings out of target
rows.effect: Toe change over bumps; tyre wear and a nervous car
rows.cause: Pickup position +/-1.0 mm on the welded frame, wishbone weld distortion +/-0.5 mm
rows.prevention: Jigged wishbones; the build-tolerance study of bump steer (Week 3); camber set at the upper wishbone's rod ends
rows.action_text: Alignment and a bump-steer gauge on the built car; shim the tie rod's inner joint if bump steer is out

rows.function: Carry the wheel loads into the bearings for three seasons
rows.mode: Fatigue crack at the spindle's shoulder
rows.effect: The hub and wheel part from the upright
rows.cause: One bending cycle per wheel revolution; a shoulder fillet; fretting under the press-fitted bearing cones on the 7075 spindle, which the check leaves out
rows.prevention: A shoulder ring and an R3 fillet (D19): Miner factor {req:S-15} over the duty spectrum (HC-4)
rows.detection: Hand calc on an assumed duty spectrum
rows.action_text: Decide between a steel spindle (or a hardened sleeve under the cones) and a fretting knock-down on the 7075 one; the measured spectrum (T-02) replaces the assumed one; inspect the spindle every season (T-08)

rows.function: Carry the wheel loads between the upright and the chassis
rows.mode: A link buckles in a kerb strike or bump, or a weld toe cracks
rows.effect: The wheel's location is lost
rows.cause: Compression in the 3 g bump and kerb cases; weld-toe fatigue at the member ends
rows.prevention: Buckling FoS {req:S-02b} with the rod-end shanks; welds and rod-end threads by Miner, factor {req:S-07b} (HC-9)
rows.action_text: Measured pushrod loads (T-02); dye penetrant at the wishbone node welds every season (T-08)

rows.function: Hold the joints' bolts in double shear
rows.mode: An ear root or a tab weld yields or cracks
rows.effect: A joint loosens, then lets go
rows.cause: Two ear roots the CAD kernel left sharp (R2 on the drawing); tab welds in bending
rows.prevention: Ear roots by a scripted hand-calculation method with Kt, calibrated to the FEA: FoS {req:S-14} (HC-7); tabs and brackets FoS {req:S-19} (HC-11)
rows.detection: Hand calcs scaled to the FEA
rows.action_text: The ears carry load in the proof test (T-04); tab welds inspected with the node welds (T-08)

rows.item: ARB lever, its drop-link bolt and the drop link
rows.function: Carry the ARB's torque into the drop link
rows.mode: The lever yields at its hub, or the single-shear bolt bends
rows.effect: The ARB stops working on that side: a balance change
rows.cause: The full-warp torque; the bolt is a cantilever beside the lever (D25)
rows.prevention: Bolt FoS {req:S-20} (S-20); lever FoS {req:S-21} (S-21); the rod end captured by a 24 mm washer (R-08)
rows.action_text: The rate test loads every bar through the levers (T-06); torque and stripe the bolt (T-07)

rows.item: ARB set-up (D26: bars swapped to adjust)
rows.function: Run the setting the setup sheet says
rows.mode: The wrong bar is fitted, or the splines fret and gain backlash after repeated swaps
rows.effect: The balance is not what the driver and the setup sheet expect; a dead band in the ARB
rows.cause: Three similar bars; swaps at the track
rows.prevention: None yet
rows.action_text: Etch each bar with its setting and diameter; the setup sheet records the bar; inspect the spline teeth at every swap (T-08); T-06 measures each bar's rate

rows.function: Allow the links to swing without binding
rows.mode: A joint binds at the end of travel (misalignment past its rating)
rows.effect: The joint's housing levers the link and its ears: overload
rows.cause: Heave, roll and steer combined at the travel limits
rows.prevention: Worst joint at least {req:V-04} deg inside its rating over the whole envelope (V-04)
rows.detection: Analysis only, over the full envelope
rows.action_text: Cycle each corner by hand through full travel and lock with the springs out, checking every joint turns freely (T-01)

rows.function: Steer, and survive the driver forcing the wheel against a blocked tyre
rows.mode: The steering arm or tie rod yields under driver effort with the wheels blocked (LC6), or the linkage goes over centre
rows.effect: Steering lost or degraded
rows.cause: The full rack force on one tie rod
rows.prevention: LC6 is in the upright FEA and the member checks; positive steering stops (R-05)
rows.action_text: Check the stops engage before the rack's own end and before any part touches, with the free-play check (T-03)

rows.function: Carry the wheel loads without play
rows.mode: Preload is lost or a race spalls
rows.effect: Play, then wheel wobble (felt before it fails)
rows.cause: Overload, or the cone spacer's preload relaxing
rows.prevention: Static safety {req:S-10} (S-10); preload set by a ground cone spacer
rows.action_text: Temperature on the endurance run (T-05); rock each wheel for play before every event (T-08)

rows.function: Brake, and let the disc float on its carrier
rows.mode: The disc cracks from thermal cycling, or the bobbins wear or seize
rows.effect: Judder; the disc loose on its carrier, or locked so it cones
rows.cause: {hc:s16_disc_T_min_C:.0f}-{hc:s16_disc_T_max_C:.0f} deg C cycles; the disc's thermal fatigue and the bobbins' wear are not analysed
rows.prevention: 410 stainless disc; titanium bobbins; disc temperature by HC-8
rows.detection: No check of the failure mode
rows.action_text: Disc and housing temperature on the endurance run (T-05); before each event, check the disc for cracks and that every bobbin still floats (T-08)

rows.item: Wheel attachment (studs and nuts on the hub)
rows.function: Hold the wheel on the hub
rows.mode: A stud or nut fails or loosens
rows.effect: The wheel comes off
rows.cause: Not detailed in this project: the hub's wheel fasteners are not sized or checked
rows.prevention: None yet
rows.action_text: Detail the wheel studs to Braid's wheel and check them for LC1-LC8 (a design task before ordering); torque and stripe the nuts (T-07) and check them before each event (T-08)

rows.function: Carry the joint loads through clamped bolts for three seasons
rows.mode: A fretting-fatigue crack at an ear hole
rows.effect: The ear cracks and the joint loosens
rows.cause: Small slip between the clamped rod end, spacers and ear as the loads reverse; the fatigue run checks the hole edges without a fretting factor
rows.prevention: Preloaded bolts from the schedule; the hole edges' Miner factor in the fatigue run
rows.action_text: Dye penetrant at the ear holes after the proof test (T-04) and each season (T-08); a fretting knock-down in the next fatigue run

rows.function: Brake within the parts' ratings
rows.mode: The line pressure exceeds the caliper's rating, or the pads and fluid pass their temperature limits
rows.effect: Brake fade or a seal failure
rows.cause: About {veh:brake_line_pressure_max_bar:.0f} bar in the combined case (the largest pad clamp force over the caliper's piston area); the disc runs at {hc:s16_disc_T_min_C:.0f}-{hc:s16_disc_T_max_C:.0f} deg C (HC-8)
rows.prevention: None yet: neither rating is checked
rows.action_text: Check Wilwood's maximum pressure for the PS-1 and the pads' and fluid's temperature ratings; a thicker disc if the temperatures run high; measure the line pressure and the temperatures on the endurance run (T-05)

tests.name: Alignment, bump steer, joint freedom and spring seating
tests.method: Set static camber, caster and toe on strings and plates. Bump-steer gauge (dial indicators on a plate bolted to the hub) from -25 to +25 mm in 5 mm steps, the springs out; cycle each corner through full travel and lock by hand, every joint turning freely. At full droop, check the main spring stays seated with the helper spring fitted
tests.acceptance: Static settings to the setup sheet; toe change within 0.1 deg over +/-25 mm; no joint binds; main spring seated at full droop

closes.V-05: Main spring seated at full droop with the helper spring

tests.name: Pushrod strain gauges (load-model correlation)
tests.method: A full-bridge gauge on each front pushrod, calibrated in tension and compression in a test machine. Log steady cornering on the skid pad, straight-line braking and a bump or kerb section. Compare the measured force per g with the force solver (member_forces.csv), and count the cycles for the duty spectrum
tests.acceptance: Measured force at most 15 % above the solver's for the matching case; otherwise scale that load case and re-run run_all.py
tests.sample: Two pushrods, three runs per manoeuvre

closes.S-07a: The measured spectrum replaces the assumed one in the Miner check

tests.name: Steering free play, stops and rack mount
tests.method: Front wheels clamped; dial indicator at the steering-wheel rim; rock the wheel to each side at 5 N m. Turn to each lock: the stops engage before the rack's own end and before any part touches. Proof-torque the rack bracket bolts to 110 % of spec
tests.acceptance: Free play under 7 deg at the wheel (R-06), and HC-10's assumed clearances replaced by the measurement; stops engage first; no bolt turns at proof torque

tests.name: Upright proof load with strain correlation
tests.method: One upright in a fixture that loads it as the car does: through a stub spindle in its bearings, with pins at the ball joints and the tie rod reacting the load as in the FEA's free body; the FEA is re-run with the fixture's own supports for the strain predictions. Load along LC4's direction to 1.2 x LC4. Rosettes where the gradients are gentle (the housing's outer wall, mid-way along the steering arm); a dial gauge for permanent set; dye penetrant afterwards, the ear holes included
tests.acceptance: Permanent set under 0.05 mm; no crack indication; strains within 10 % of the fixture-matched FEA at the rosettes

closes.S-06f: Strains within 10 % of the fixture-matched FEA: a direct check of the model
closes.S-07a: No crack at proof load; the baseline for the inspection interval (T-08)

tests.name: Hub, housing and disc temperature
tests.method: A K-type thermocouple on the housing beside the outboard cup seat, irreversible temperature labels on the housing, the caliper lug and the disc carrier, a pressure transducer in the front brake line; an endurance-length run (22 km) at event pace and a set of hard stops
tests.acceptance: Housing at most 120 deg C; cup seat at most 150 deg C; line pressure and pad temperature within Wilwood's ratings (to confirm)
tests.when: Shakedown, then the first endurance practice

tests.name: ARB rate per bar, and the balance shift with ride height
tests.method: Corner-weight scales: jack one front wheel in 5 mm steps and read the load change with each bar and with the drop links off; derive each bar's roll stiffness. Tilt table with the wheel scales (a static lateral load, so the share includes the part the links carry): the front share of the total lateral load transfer at static ride height and 15 mm lower, middle bar
tests.acceptance: Each bar's roll stiffness within 10 % of notes/vehicle_calcs.md; the change in the front share between the two ride heights within 1.5 points of the front-only prediction, or explained by the rear roll centre's movement

closes.K-08a: The shift measured and matched to the prediction, so the setup sheet accounts for it

tests.name: Fastener torque and proof
tests.method: Torque every bolt to the schedule and stripe it; proof-torque the caliper and rack bracket bolts to 110 % of spec
tests.acceptance: Every bolt at its torque and striped; no bolt turns at proof torque

tests.name: Inspection schedule
tests.method: Before each event: torque stripes, wheel-bearing play (rock each wheel), the disc for cracks and every bobbin floating, the ARB bar fitted against the setup sheet and its spline teeth at any swap, the wheel nuts. At an interval set from the measured spectrum (a judgement until then) and after any kerb strike: dye penetrant at the upright's bore edge and ear holes. Each season: magnetic-particle inspection of the hub spindle and the ARB bar's shoulder and splines; dye penetrant at the wishbone node and tab welds
tests.acceptance: No crack indication; no broken stripe; no measurable bearing play; every bobbin floats; spline teeth free of fretting
tests.when: Before each event, every 500 km, each season
